dialogues.jp:
頭や肩にはりついた桜の花びらをはたきながら
ようやく見えてきた我が家を見上げる。
dialogues.en:
Brushing the cherry blossom petals off my shoulders and
head, I look up at my home as it gets closer.
dialogues.text:
Brushing the cherry blossom petals off my shoulders and
head, I look up at my home as it gets closer.

dialogues.jp: 「ベッドが恋しいなぁ」
dialogues.en: "I wish I were in bed now."
dialogues.text: "I wish I were in bed now."

dialogues.jp: ぽかぽか。
dialogues.en: Nice and warm.
dialogues.text: Nice and warm.

dialogues.jp: 空気はいい具合に暖かいし、風も気持ちいい。
dialogues.en:
The air is comfortably warm and there's a nice gentle breeze
blowing.
dialogues.text:
The air is comfortably warm and there's a nice gentle breeze
blowing.

dialogues.jp:
おまけに、家の玄関の前でさくらがお怒りのご
様子で立っている。
dialogues.en:
And what's more, Sakura's standing on the porch with an
angry look.
dialogues.text:
And what's more, Sakura's standing on the porch with an
angry look.

dialogues.jp: 「……なにやってるんだお前？」
dialogues.en: "What are you doing here?"
dialogues.text: "What are you doing here?"

dialogues.jp: 鞄をかつぎなおして見下ろす。
dialogues.en: I put my bag over my shoulder again and look down at her.
dialogues.text: I put my bag over my shoulder again and look down at her.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃんを待ってたんだよ」
dialogues.en: "I've been waiting for you, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "I've been waiting for you, oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「俺をわざわざ？」
dialogues.en: "What for?"
dialogues.text: "What for?"

dialogues.jp:
俺自身が禁止しておいてなんだが、窓から入っ
てくればいいのにと思う。
dialogues.en:
Even though I told her not to, I wonder why she didn't enter
the house through the window.
dialogues.text:
Even though I told her not to, I wonder why she didn't enter
the house through the window.

dialogues.jp: 「どこか行きたいところでもあるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you have anywhere you want to go?"
dialogues.text: "Do you have anywhere you want to go?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……ボクはお兄ちゃんの部屋に行きたいんだ
　よ」
dialogues.en: "I want to go to your room."
dialogues.text: "I want to go to your room."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……殺し文句やな」
dialogues.en: "That's incriminating, isn't it?"
dialogues.text: "That's incriminating, isn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんでもない」
dialogues.en: "Nothing."
dialogues.text: "Nothing."

dialogues.jp:
そっぽを向きつつ、ポケットから家の鍵をとり
だす。
dialogues.en: Looking the other way, I take the house key from my pocket.
dialogues.text: Looking the other way, I take the house key from my pocket.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あにゅう〜」

腰元にへばりついて俺を家に帰させようとしない
不思議な物体がいる。
dialogues.en:
There's a strange creature clinging around my waist, not
letting me go inside my house.
dialogues.text:
There's a strange creature clinging around my waist, not
letting me go inside my house.

dialogues.jp: 「だから、なんの用事だお前は？」
dialogues.en: "Why the heck are you here?"
dialogues.text: "Why the heck are you here?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「これだよコレ！」
dialogues.en: "Look at THIS!"
dialogues.text: "Look at THIS!"

dialogues.jp: さくらがビシィ、と札をかざす。
dialogues.en: Sakura holds up a piece of paper.
dialogues.text: Sakura holds up a piece of paper.

dialogues.jp: 「魔法少女ごっこか？　はにゃ〜ん言って見ろ」
dialogues.en: "Are you playing a magical girl? Say Haann~"
dialogues.text: "Are you playing a magical girl? Say Haann~"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……はにゃ〜ん？」
dialogues.en: "Haann~?"
dialogues.text: "Haann~?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「意気込みが足りないな」
dialogues.en: "You have to be more enthusiastic than that."
dialogues.text: "You have to be more enthusiastic than that."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「意気込みって……うーにゅ」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean by enthusiastic? Mmmm."
dialogues.text: "What do you mean by enthusiastic? Mmmm."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: ようやく、さくらの手の中の札をよく見た。
dialogues.en: I can finally read the note in her hand.
dialogues.text: I can finally read the note in her hand.

dialogues.jp: 『悪霊退散』
dialogues.en: 'EXPEL EVIL SPIRITS'
dialogues.text: 'EXPEL EVIL SPIRITS'

dialogues.jp:
さくらは魔法少女に見せかけて巫女さんだった
――もとい、昨日の夜に冗談で貼ったやつだ。
dialogues.en:
Sakura pretends to be a priestess acting like a magical girl
- But anyway. I actually made that note as a joke last
night.
dialogues.text:
Sakura pretends to be a priestess acting like a magical girl
- But anyway. I actually made that note as a joke last
night.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「これはどういう意味かな？」
dialogues.en: "Can you explain what it means?"
dialogues.text: "Can you explain what it means?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あぁ……なんだ……俺の部屋に地縛霊が引っ
　越してきたから巫女さんが貼ってったんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, I see. A priestess put it up for me because an evil
demon moved into my room."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, I see. A priestess put it up for me because an evil
demon moved into my room."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Waaaah~~~"
dialogues.text: "Waaaah~~~"

dialogues.jp:
おかしな泣き声を上げながら、さくらが自分の
家に逃げ出してしまう。
dialogues.en: Crying in a strange way, Sakura runs off to her house.
dialogues.text: Crying in a strange way, Sakura runs off to her house.

dialogues.jp: ぽりぽり。
dialogues.en: Scratch, scratch.
dialogues.text: Scratch, scratch.

dialogues.jp: 「……かったりぃなぁ」
dialogues.en: "What a pain..."
dialogues.text: "What a pain..."

dialogues.jp:
部屋に戻った俺が一番最初にしたことは、鞄を
投げて紙切れとマジックを用意することだった。
dialogues.en:
The first thing I did when I got to my room is drop my bag
and get a piece of paper and a marker pen.
dialogues.text:
The first thing I did when I got to my room is drop my bag
and get a piece of paper and a marker pen.

dialogues.jp:
その後、部屋の窓に“千客万来”と書かれた紙
を貼っつけておいたのは音夢には秘密だ。
dialogues.en:
After that, I put up a piece of paper on the window in my
room that says 'A SUCCESSION OF VISITORS'. But I'd better
keep it a secret from Nemu.
dialogues.text:
After that, I put up a piece of paper on the window in my
room that says 'A SUCCESSION OF VISITORS'. But I'd better
keep it a secret from Nemu.

dialogues.jp: ◆悪霊退散の札◆
dialogues.en: ◆A tag to expel evil spirits◆
dialogues.text: ◆A tag to expel evil spirits◆

dialogues.jp:
前日の夜にはりつけた“悪霊退散”の札を手に
怒れるさくらに詰め寄られるが、その押しも弱
く、すぐに泣きながら逃げ帰ってしまった。
dialogues.en:
Sakura was very upset and confronted me when she saw the
note I put up last night which says 'EXPEL EVIL SPIRITS'.
But she ended up running home crying.
dialogues.text:
Sakura was very upset and confronted me when she saw the
note I put up last night which says 'EXPEL EVIL SPIRITS'.
But she ended up running home crying.

dialogues.jp:
仕方なく“先客万来”と書いた札を、今度は貼
り付ける俺だった。
dialogues.en:
So I had to put up a piece of paper that says 'A SUCCESSION
OF VISITORS' instead.
dialogues.text:
So I had to put up a piece of paper that says 'A SUCCESSION
OF VISITORS' instead.
